display_name: Agent Runway: Canadian Real Estate Analytics
description: Connect your AI assistant to your Agent Runway real estate business data. 22 read tools cover transactions, pipeline deals, CRM clients, CASL consent, expenses, mileage and the CRA vehicle logbook, tax estimates, forecasts and what the in-app AI changed, and read a pasted call or showing note into proposed changes. 10 write tools create and update pipeline opportunities, save the note items the agent approves, record CASL consent and withdrawals, and log trips, logbook periods and odometer readings.

authentication.description: The Supabase access token (JWT) from a signed-in Agent Runway session on an account with Pro access, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. It expires after about an hour. There are no API keys, and OAuth is not available.

tools.name: get_server_info
tools.description: Returns MCP server version and available tools list.

tools.name: get_dashboard_kpis
tools.description: YTD GCI, transactions, expenses, pipeline value, goal progress.

tools.name: get_runway_score
tools.description: 0-100 composite business health grade (A+ to F).

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Projected year-end GCI based on pace and pipeline.

tools.name: get_tax_estimate
tools.description: Canadian income tax estimate with CPP, federal/provincial tax, quarterly instalments.

tools.name: get_hst_status
tools.description: GST/HST estimate for the current year: collected, ITCs, net owing, next filing deadline.

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Closed transactions with address, sale price, GCI, side, date.

tools.name: get_transaction_summary
tools.description: Aggregate GCI, deal count, volume by year.

tools.name: get_pipeline
tools.description: Active pipeline deals with stage, probability, weighted GCI.

tools.name: get_pipeline_forecast
tools.description: Stage-by-stage pipeline breakdown with goal coverage ratio.

tools.name: list_opportunities
tools.description: Listing appointments, buyer prospects and referrals, with conversion KPIs.

tools.name: create_opportunity
tools.description: Logs a new listing appointment, buyer prospect or referral.

tools.name: promote_opportunity
tools.description: Turns a listing appointment or referral into a pipeline deal.

tools.name: advance_buyer_prospect_stage
tools.description: Moves a buyer prospect pipeline deal to offer, conditional or firm.

tools.name: mark_opportunity_lost
tools.description: Marks an opportunity lost with a structured reason. Lost is a final status.

tools.name: get_clients
tools.description: CRM client list with flight status, contact info, property interest.

tools.name: get_client_detail
tools.description: Detailed client profile with activities and linked pipeline deals.

tools.name: get_expenses
tools.description: YTD expenses by category with monthly recurring totals.

tools.name: get_mileage_summary
tools.description: Business km for a year, with CRA's per-km allowance benchmark (an employer-allowance figure, not a deduction) and the vehicle business-use share.

tools.name: get_logbook_status
tools.description: CRA vehicle logbook: vehicles, base-year and sample periods with progress, odometer readings due, the year's vehicle business-use share and CRA's 10% test.

tools.name: log_mileage
tools.description: Logs a business trip, with km or the odometer at its start and end.

tools.name: start_logbook_period
tools.description: Starts a CRA logbook base year (12 months) or sample period (3 months) from the 1st of a month.

tools.name: record_odometer_reading
tools.description: Records an odometer reading the logbook lists as due: a period's start or end, or a base year's month end.

tools.name: get_flight_control_priorities
tools.description: Outreach queue: clients due for follow-up, with drafted messages waiting for review.

tools.name: get_user_settings
tools.description: Agent profile, goals, business settings, subscription status.

tools.name: capture_note
tools.description: Reads a pasted call or showing note into proposed activities, Checklist follow-ups, deal changes, trips and expenses, with client matches. Saves nothing.

tools.name: save_captured_note
tools.description: Saves the note items the agent approved, through the same writers the Agent Runway app uses.

tools.name: get_client_consent
tools.description: One client's CASL consent per channel (email, texts): express, implied until a date, lapsed, unsubscribed or no record, with the records behind it.

tools.name: list_consent_lapsing
tools.description: Past clients whose implied consent from their purchase ends soon or just ended.

tools.name: record_consent
tools.description: Record consent a client gave the agent (express, or an inquiry), with how and when.

tools.name: withdraw_consent
tools.description: Record that a client asked the agent to stop emailing or texting them.

tools.name: get_ai_activity
tools.description: What the in-app AI changed in the agent's records and which AI calls ran (failures, estimated cost). No prompts or replies.
